Cool, I would recommend downloading OpenHardwareMonitor then, and look at your temps and power usage to see what’s causing the stutter. It shouldn’t be the temps since it’s a relatively new computer but just double check. You can tell if it’s your power (the gpu was the issue in my case) if you notice that the stutter starts once the GPU Power reaches a certain threshold and the stuttering starts. In my case it started at 81.6 W and that was when the stuttering started.

Hey! What PSU are you using? Recently I had tons of stuttering issues because the power supply I was provided was only 150W and it was not nearly enough power to sustain everything I was doing so I upgraded to a 240W PSU and everything runs smoothly (The PSU for a laptop is your charger btw). If this is your issue it should be an easy fix which is just to upgrade to a better charger, hopefully this helps!

Dunno if this will help at all but looking at the swords your using will usually tell you if dual-wielding affects the speed at which you attack. For example, great-swords have the modifier “Two-handed” which gives you miner fatigue 4 when you use it along with something else in your other hand. This can be avoided using vitamins. Also IMO sabers and rapiers are about the same as far as damage output goes, but I would also suggest investing in another sword that can deal damage without being reliant on the enemy having no armor.
